title: Math Mania
description: Fast-paced arithmetic challenge — type answers quickly to rack up points.
how_to_play:
1. Press Enter to start.
2. Type the answer to the arithmetic shown and press Enter.
3. Correct answers increase score. Wrong answers or timeouts cost lives.
4. Try to get a high score!

Tips:
- Start slow and focus on accuracy.
- Speed increases with your score.
